verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph and the Teams platform expose broad programmatic control — creating teams/channels, posting messages, bots, tabs, message extensions, exporting chat content — enough to automate many core scenarios, and Microsoft explicitly frames Graph as a way to 'automate Teams scenarios' outside the UI. However, the docs pack shows no evidence of full API parity for meetings/calling, reactions, message editing/threading, or other rich UI-only behaviors, and community feedback focuses on UI complaints rather than confirming API completeness. Missing for 10: documented API coverage for meetings/calls/voice, message reactions and editing, and any independent confirmation of full UI-API parity.
